title: FRS — Síntesis de datos SLV2013
summary: A Python pipeline that generates synthetic survey data from the 2013 El Salvador adolescent risk-factor survey (SLV2013), preserving distributions, missing-data patterns, and derived-indicator coherence. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, built from a SingleTableMetadata object, to fit and sample synthetic replicas of the survey's Q-columns.
